Wrestling Wars: Who Really Runs Wrestling? Roman Reigns, MJF, Cody Rhodes, CM Punk or Will Ospreay 👑

carousel // Oct 16, 2026

See it on Instagram

Five megastars. Two companies. One throne. And you're wrong about at least three of them. 👑

Welcome to Wrestling Wars, round one: who really runs wrestling right now? Three from WWE, two from AEW. Swipe the contender files, then rank 'em 1 to 5.

The cover: now it's your turn

Comment your pick, call out who got robbed, name who's overrated, and follow for round two.

Contender 1: Roman Reigns, The Tribal Chief

Did the Bloodline make Roman Reigns, or did he carry the Bloodline? Roman was already a main-event star before the faction. But his 1,316-day run as Universal Champion, from 2020 to WrestleMania 40 in 2024, happened with the whole family behind him. Would he be the megastar he is today without them?

Contender 2: MJF, The Devil

Generational on the mic, or just cheap heat? Take away the insults, the shock value and the controversy. Can MJF still outtalk everybody and be the biggest star in the building?

Contender 3: Cody Rhodes, The American Nightmare

Cody finished the story at WrestleMania 40. But was the chase more compelling than watching him hold the title? Is he the people's champion, or WWE's safest pick?

Contender 4: CM Punk, Best in the World

Best in the world, or wrestling's biggest lightning rod? Since he came back to WWE in 2023, everybody has an opinion on Punk. Does the controversy add to his star power, or distract from what he does in the ring?

Contender 5: Will Ospreay, The Aerial Assassin

Best between the ropes, no question. But do incredible matches alone make someone wrestling's biggest star, or is there more to carrying the whole business?

Drop your verdict

Three questions:

  • Rank your top 5: Roman, MJF, Cody, Punk and Ospreay, in your exact 1 to 5 order.
  • Who's overrated? Call out the weak link among these five.
  • Who got robbed? Name your write-in contender.

Your official fan ballot

The last slide is yours. Screenshot the ballot, fill in your #1 Final Boss down to your #5 Overrated, add your most overrated and biggest robbery, then post it to your story and tag @xenofinaldawn.

Sources: Wikipedia: Roman Reigns, Wikipedia: Cody Rhodes, Wikipedia: CM Punk, Wikipedia: MJF, Wikipedia: Will Ospreay

Quick answers

Who are the five contenders in XFD Wrestling Wars? Roman Reigns, MJF, Cody Rhodes, CM Punk and Will Ospreay.

Which companies are they in? Roman Reigns, Cody Rhodes and CM Punk are in WWE. MJF and Will Ospreay are in AEW.

How long was Roman Reigns' Universal Championship reign? 1,316 days, ending at WrestleMania 40 in April 2024, when Cody Rhodes beat him to finish the story.

How do I vote? Comment your 1 to 5 ranking on the Instagram post, or fill in the fan ballot, post it to your story and tag @xenofinaldawn.

Your turn

Defend your #1 below. No fence-sitting. 👇
